title: 조선중앙텔레비죤 test card and sign-on, off Thaicom 5
notes: the test card's clock running out the last ten seconds to a 17:00 sign-on, then Paektu at dusk, the portrait on a black field and a massed choir — taken off Thaicom 5 at a low elevation, which the recordist notes was harder to receive then than now
